about: EVO Cabinet request profile (sm-05 · Finalizat) vs the BO originals — svc-01 (header meta, passport card / rows) and dos-01 (sections, card). Run: node --experimental-websocket --no-warnings tools/ui-qa/compare-styles.mjs --a svc-01 --b sm-05 --spec tools/ui-qa/specs/cabinet-profile-vs-bo.json. 2026-10-17 alignment with RAP. cabinet-header-v1 (2026-10-21): the Cabinet act / request header IS the BO page header (js/page-header.js) — pairs header body / top / heading / breadcrumb / aside / actions / action button added; the act profile has its own run (--b pp-01d).
